gaps.sentence: The economy shows signs of ___ (RECOVER) after the recession.

gaps.explanation: People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: He has a wide ___ (KNOW) of local history.
The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.
